payload.reason: The evidence provides specific references to previous works that utilized morphological information in both Statistical Machine Translation (SMT) and Neural Machine Translation (NMT).

claims.text: Previous work considered morphological information for both SMT and NMT, including methods that integrate word-level annotation and utilize morphological features on both source and target sides.
BIBREF11 is noted for being the first to leverage morphological information in NMT architecture, although it does not consider target-side morphology.
BIBREF10 is mentioned as the first attempt to model inflection through a neural method integrated into an SMT architecture.
